create_cutmixup_collator: create a data collator that applies CutMix and MixUp augmentations to image batches with configurable alpha and probability
build_Mixup_transform: build a Mixup/Cutmix transform object with configurable alpha values, mixing probability, and per-batch or per-element mixing modes
run_MixupTransform_augment: run a MixupTransform augmentation that applies mixup coefficients sampled from a Beta distribution to input tensors and target labels
test_cutmix_bbox_and_lam: test cutmix bounding box generation with lambda correction for images clipped by image borders
summarize_mixup_target: summarize how mixup_target blends original and flipped one-hot labels with a mixing coefficient and label smoothing
